title: Sparkly light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='42%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF7B0' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFF7B0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bulb' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFBE0'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#FFE45C'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFC13B'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cap' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#B8C4CE'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#E8EEF2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9AA7B2'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- bulb glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='23' fill='url(#bulb)'/>
  <path d='M41 56 L59 56 L58 64 Q50 70 42 64 Z' fill='#FFD84D'/>

  <!-- filament hint -->

  <!-- screw cap -->
  <rect x='41' y='64' width='18' height='5' rx='2' fill='url(#cap)'/>
  <rect x='42' y='70' width='16' height='5' rx='2' fill='url(#cap)'/>
  <rect x='43' y='76' width='14' height='5' rx='2' fill='url(#cap)'/>
  <path d='M45 82 Q50 88 55 82' fill='#8E9AA5'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#7FE7FF'>

  </g>
  <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
    <path d='M18 60 L20 65 L25 67 L20 69 L18 74 L16 69 L11 67 L16 65 Z'/>

  </g>
  <g fill='#B4F0FF'>
    <circle cx='12' cy='42' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='46' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='90' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
